verdict.rationale: Community evidence (e.g., fedora-comm-5, fedora-comm-16) confirms official KDE Spin variants exist and are used by power-users alongside the GNOME-based Workstation, supporting the story that alternate desktop environments are offered. However, the official docs pack only describes the GNOME Workstation edition and never mentions Spins, other DE options, or how default apps differ across variants. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the Spins program, list of officially supported desktop environments, and default app differences per variant.
